issues.description: Users report being unable to log in, including failures with phone-number login and repeated errors.
Users are signed out, locked out, or rejected when trying to return to an existing account.
Users specifically report that phone-number login does not work.
Users say the app does not allow them to log in or access their account, with little detail about the cause.
Users report being unable to log in, sometimes citing a generic error message or repeated unsuccessful attempts.
